glosses: possibly, probably; as I was told (modal particle expressing an assumption, often like English must + infinitive, or (US) guess + clause)
of course, indeed (modal particle adding stress to the statement to contradict a preceding one, often like English do + infinitive)
actually, somehow, quite (modal particle making the statement weaker or expressing a concession)

examples.text: Ich denke, ich sollte wohl gehen.
examples.en: I think I probably should go.
